title: Finite convex certificates for quadratic informational substitutes
description: For a scalar square-integrable target and two finite signals, this work gives a necessary-and-sufficient finite convex completion characterization of quadratic informational substitution with arbitrary joint support. It derives an attained sharp-coefficient formulation when finite, an equal-mean compatibility criterion, rational strict rejection witnesses, and the explicit directed-pair specialization under full support. Sparse scalar and full-support vector examples delimit pairwise tests. The universal statements are analytic; exact rational computations are supplementary checks, not formal verification. The work is AI-assisted and has not undergone external human peer review. Original prose and data: CC0-1.0; original code: MIT.
